_note: Timed by the group (Amna, Sarita, Subhan) with a stopwatch on sample controls; results matched the planning estimates, so those values are kept. Review time is charged per suggestion: the earlier flat 3 minutes per control was set when the run produced 74 suggestions, and the reviewed run produced 139.

manual.basis: Group timing of manual mapping on sample controls averaged about 20 minutes per control across seven frameworks (235 requirements); requirement status and gap ranking for all 235 requirements about 150 minutes.
manual.description: Analyst reads each control, searches framework catalogs, records mappings, then works out requirement coverage by hand

ai_assisted.basis: Group timing of reviewing AI suggestions: about 1 minute per suggestion (read the requirement, read the rationale, accept or reject with a note). Charged against the number of suggestions the run actually produced, so the figure cannot drift when the mapper returns more or fewer rows.
ai_assisted.description: Analyst reviews and approves each AI suggested mapping; AI runtime is measured automatically from the run log
